findings.text: The company was incorporated on 20 March 2013 and ceased on 8 April 2014, an age at cessation of 1.1 years (384 days).
A high-severity red flag is recorded because the company is dissolved.

The accounts and confirmation statement are of unknown overdue status, and their next due and last made up to dates are not recorded.
No current person with significant control is on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner.
No charges are registered against the company.
PERSON 366 has no other appointments on record, and no other companies were found across the one current director checked.
No registered office address changes and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
